issues.explanation: The visual claims that RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300, min_samples_leaf=5) produces the 0.98 training AUC and 0.83 test AUC on the simulated churn table, but facts.json documents only n_trees = 300 (with train_auc = 0.982 and test.auc = 0.831) and never states min_samples_leaf = 5. Also, reusing X[train] and X[test] from seg3 visual without make_pipeline(prep, ...) would fail on the string column vertical.
issues.evidence: facts.json -> forest: {"n_trees": 300, "train_auc": 0.982, "test": {"auc": 0.831}}; model_table[3]: {"model": "Random forest, 300 trees"} (min_samples_leaf is absent from facts.json).
issues.fix: Omit min_samples_leaf=5 from the snippet (or add min_samples_leaf to forest in facts.json) and wrap the estimator in the pipeline from seg3: model = make_pipeline(prep, RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300)).

verdict: Factually strong and conceptually sound lesson; all dataset counts, splits, feature totals, and AUC figures match facts.json, with only one minor unsupported hyperparameter (min_samples_leaf=5) in the seg4 code visual.
